name: MOTS-c Mitochondrial Energy Protocol
title: MOTS-c Mitochondrial Energy Protocol
description: Clinical peptide protocol designed for cellular regeneration and systemic optimization.
clinicalRationale: Engineered according to clinical peptide consensus and pharmacokinetic half-life parameters.
clinical_rationale: Engineered according to clinical peptide consensus and pharmacokinetic half-life parameters.
evidenceGradeNote: Grade B: MOTS-c Phase I clinical evaluation (CB4211 human trials; Lee C, Cell Metab 2015). SS-31 (Elamipretide) supported by Phase II randomized trials in mitochondrial bioenergetics and exercise tolerance (Karaa A et al., Neurology 2018; NEJM 2023).
evidence_grade_note: Grade B: MOTS-c Phase I clinical evaluation (CB4211 human trials; Lee C, Cell Metab 2015). SS-31 (Elamipretide) supported by Phase II randomized trials in mitochondrial bioenergetics and exercise tolerance (Karaa A et al., Neurology 2018; NEJM 2023).
contraindications: Active malignancy or uninvestigated neoplastic lesions
Severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh Class C) or end-stage renal disease
relativeCautions: History of cardiac arrhythmia or severe hypertension
Concurrent administration of insulin secretagogues without dose adjustment
expectedOutcomes: Restoration of target cellular and metabolic signaling pathways
Documented improvement in clinical biomarkers and subjective vigor
Sustained systemic resilience and tissue regeneration

compounds.name: MOTS-c
compounds.timing: Morning • Fasted • 30–60 min prior to exercise
compounds.storage: Refrigerate at 2°C – 8°C. Highly heat sensitive. Protect from thermal spikes.
compounds.clinicalNotes: Mitochondrial-derived peptide stimulating AMPK phosphorylation. Administer strictly before exercise in the morning; avoid evening use.
